newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SCHUMACHER IN TROUBLE FOR ALLEGED ATTACK ON LINESMAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHUMACHER IN TROUBLE FOR ALLEGED ATTACK ON LINESMAN.

text.p: Germany's controversial former goalkeeper Toni Schumacher, widely remembered for an atrocious foul on French defender Patrick Battiston during the 1982 World Cup finals, is in trouble again for another alleged attack.

German soccer officials said on Tuesday that they were investigating allegations that Schumacher, now a coach at Borussia Dortmund, had elbowed an official in the ribs at halftime of Dortmund's league match with Schalke last Saturday.
Schumacher is said to have been angry that the officials did not award a goal to Dortmund just before halftime.

A report from referee Juergen Jansen claims that he elbowed linesman Klaus Plettenberg twice when he was returning to the dressing rooms. The German soccer federation has given the 42-year-old Schumacher until Thursday to comment.
